title: A ladder of tests, one answer
caption: Python tries the tests top to bottom and stops at the first true one, so a reading of 3.62 m never reaches the rungs below. Write the same tests as four separate ifs and every true one runs, which at 3.62 m means the mildest message is the one left standing.

cells.label: if level >= 3.50
cells.note: leave now — nothing below is even read

cells.label: elif level >= 3.00
cells.note: move your car — only asked if the rung above was false

cells.label: else
cells.note: nothing to do — the rung that needs no test
